instruction: A sleek visor-style VR headset in matte black with angular armor panels and thin magenta-and-cyan light strips glowing along its edges. A holographic HUD flickers across the mirrored lens, and exposed ribbon cabling and a neon-etched logo give it a gritty near-future vibe.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Cyberpunk VR Headset in a cyberpunk style. A sleek visor-style VR headset in matte black with angular armor panels and thin magenta-and-cyan light strips glowing along its edges. A holographic HUD flickers across the mirrored lens, and exposed ribbon cabling and a neon-etched logo give it a gritty near-future vibe. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
